_comment: IOC catalog for post-aggregation severity re-scoring. All 'match'/'keyword' entries are lowercase and matched as case-insensitive substrings against an evidence item's value + evidence_type. Severity is a FLOOR: an item is boosted up to this level on match, never downgraded.

indicators._comment: WannaCry unpacked component/resource files (c/s/t/u/b/r.wnry, m_*.wnry language packs). Strong corroborating evidence, but not the dropper/decryptor itself, so floored at high (not critical). '.wnry' is distinct from '.wncry'/'.wcry' (handled by wannacry_decryptor), so no overlap.
Canonical WannaCry killswitch/sinkhole domain. Recovered as a string IOC at medium; cataloguing it gives it an ioc_match so it becomes a Key Finding and is escalated.
General rule: any .onion address recovered from memory is C2-grade. Substring-matches the TLD so it generalises to any malware, not just WannaCry's documented onions.
WannaCry hard-coded BTC ransom wallets (lowercased for case-insensitive substring match against the lowercased haystack).

bad_hosts._comment: Domain / IP reputation list (issue 4.2). Matched HOST-AWARE — a domain matches only when an extracted host equals it or is a subdomain of it; an IP matches only on an exact dotted-quad token — against any item's value (so it catches dns_query / http_request / network_connection AND memory-recovered suspicious_domain). Severity is a floor (boost-only). This is curated named threat-intel, the same curation philosophy as the named-malware / wallet entries above; feed additional per-case known-bad indicators via case_context.known_bad_hosts (domains or IPs). Seed entries are the confirmed C2 of the bundled macOS infostealer sample: rapid-craft567.com is the low-entropy READABLE C2 domain that the 3.2 DNS entropy gate deliberately leaves for reputation matching here, and 165.245.215.18 is its hosting IP (ties the otherwise-low TCP connections + /contact beacons to the same infrastructure).
